name.en: Al Amal Psychiatric Hospital
services.note: Federal (EHS) psychiatric hospital serving Dubai and the Northern Emirates, JCI-accredited. Runs outpatient clinics for children, adults, older people and addiction, and since 2022 a weekly clinic for autism and ADHD for children and adolescents. Adult ADHD care is not described.
notes: Address and phone not found in the sources checked; eligibility for visitors not stated. Private Dubai clinics direct out-of-hours psychiatric emergencies here.

name.en: Al Barsha Health Center
location.address.en: Al Barsha 2, Street B72, Dubai
hours: Diabetes Clinic Tue 07:30–14:30 (2022 catalogue). Children's ADHD clinic Tue 14:30–21:30 (2020 report).
services.note: Diabetes Clinic for treatment and follow-up, open to UAE nationals, residents, expats and visitors (2022 DHA catalogue). A January 2020 news report said DHA opened specialist ADHD clinics for children aged 6–12 at Al Barsha, Al Mizhar (Sun 07:30–14:30) and Nad Al Hammar (Thu 07:30–14:30) health centres, by referral from a family doctor. Confirm these still run.

name.en: Al Jalila Children's Hospital
location.address.en: Al Jaddaf, Dubai
hours: Clinics Mon–Thu 08:00–17:30, Fri 09:00–11:30, Sun 09:00–14:30; paediatric emergency 24/7.
services.note: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Center of Excellence (up to age 18) lists ADHD and offers psychiatric, psychological and behavioural assessment, psychometric testing and outpatient medication management, plus day and intensive outpatient programmes. Paediatric Endocrinology treats diabetes (pumps, CGM and education not described on the page). Book online or on 800 60 (24/7).

name.en: American Hospital Dubai
services.note: Psychiatry and Behavioral Health diagnoses and treats ADHD in children and adults after a comprehensive evaluation; stimulant and non-stimulant medicines are prescribed. Diabetes, Endocrinology and Nutrition sees patients of all ages with a strong focus on education; Paediatric Endocrinology lists comprehensive diabetes care, insulin pump therapy and continuous glucose monitoring. Book through the hospital's online form.
notes: Address and phone were not on the pages checked; use the hospital website.

name.en: Clinic for Health and Medical Care (CHMC)
organization: CHMC German Clinic for Psychiatry and Psychology
location.address.en: Al Razi Building No. 64, Block B, 3rd Floor, Clinic 3006, Dubai Healthcare City, Dubai
location.locationNote: Second branch: HDS Business Centre, Cluster M, 10th Floor, Unit 1004, JLT
services.note: Assesses and treats ADHD in people aged 16 and over (does not treat children under 16). A consultant psychiatrist assesses before prescribing; methylphenidate, lisdexamfetamine and atomoxetine are named as options. The clinic notes that stimulants are strictly regulated in the UAE and only authorised doctors can prescribe them.

name.en: Dr. Rami Hamed Center (DRHC)
location.address.en: Building 52, Dubai Healthcare City, Dubai
location.locationNote: Second branch: Tulip Oasis 9, Wadi Al Safa 3, Majan
services.note: Sexual health (STD) clinic advertising '100% confidential' HIV testing, including rapid tests with results in 30 minutes, and STI testing. PEP and PrEP are not mentioned. Note: UAE rules require health facilities to notify the health authority of HIV cases.

name.en: Dubai Diabetes Center
location.address.en: Al Hudaiba Awards Buildings, Block C, First Floor, southern end of 2nd of December Street, Al Hudaiba, Dubai
services.note: Dedicated diabetes centre for adults and children (paediatric clinic up to age 18 led by a paediatric endocrinologist). Adult services include diabetes education, antenatal diabetes, an insulin pump clinic, psychological support and a foot care (podiatry) clinic; CGM sensor insertion and data review; dietitians and a demonstration kitchen; on-site pharmacy and lab. The 2020 catalogue lists visitors as eligible for adult and paediatric diabetes, education, lab, eye screening, podiatry and pharmacy services. Book on 800 60.
notes: Now listed by Dubai Health simply as 'Diabetes Center'.

name.en: Dubai Hospital
location.address.en: Al Khaleej Street, Al Baraha, Dubai
hours: Endocrinology clinic Tue 15:00–21:00, Fri 07:30–12:00; Diabetes clinic Mon 07:30–15:00; emergency 24/7 walk-in (2022 catalogue).
services.note: Adult Endocrinology runs an insulin pump clinic and diabetes education (educator Mon & Wed 08:00–15:00, Tue 15:00–21:00, Fri 08:00–15:00); General Surgery does diabetic foot and wound care. Services are open to visitors. 2022 charges: endocrinology consultation AED 225 and emergency AED 187.50 for self-pay/non-UAE nationals (usually billed to insurance). Fast 7–8 hours before the first endocrinology visit.

name.en: Emirates Hospital Jumeirah
services.note: Group Diabetes Center: type 1, type 2 and paediatric and adolescent diabetes clinics, insulin pumps, CGM, diabetic foot clinic and dietitians, at Emirates Hospital Jumeirah, Emirates Specialty Hospital (DHCC) and group clinics. The group's psychiatry service has an adult ADHD page (clinical evaluation; stimulant and non-stimulant medicines) without saying which sites offer it.

name.en: The LightHouse Arabia
location.address.en: 821 Al Wasl Rd, Al Safa 2, Dubai
location.locationNote: Second branch: Ibn Sina Building, Block B, 27B, Ground Floor, Unit 003, Dubai Healthcare City
services.note: Psychological and psychiatric clinic. Child and adolescent diagnostic assessments cover ADHD (e.g. Conners 4 for ages 6–18, attention and executive-function testing); psychiatrists provide medication management for teens and adults with ADHD. Adult psychiatrists usually see people from 16. Prescriptions can't be issued through online consultations; people living abroad can get a second-opinion report but not a prescription. For out-of-hours emergencies the clinic refers to Al Amal hospital.

name.en: Mediclinic City Hospital
services.note: Mediclinic's endocrinology and diabetes service (page under City Hospital) runs diabetes clinics for adults and children, offers CGM, 'insulin or diabetes technology' and structured education for newly diagnosed people with certified diabetes educators; 'some' Mediclinic hospitals run a diabetic foot clinic. The page covers hospitals in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain without saying which offer what. International patient coordination is available.
notes: Network-level information and no address in the sources checked: confirm services and location of City Hospital with Mediclinic.

name.en: Rashid Hospital
location.address.en: 315 Umm Hurair Second, Dubai
hours: Emergency department 24/7, walk-in. Infectious Diseases Clinic Wed & Thu 08:00–14:30; Communicable Diseases Clinic Tue 08:00–14:30 (2022 catalogue).
services.note: The 2022 service catalogue lists an 'HIV/AIDS program' within Infectious Diseases and names UAE nationals, residents, expats and visitors as eligible; it does not say whether HIV testing, PEP or antiretroviral treatment are given to non-nationals. Diabetic Clinic (Internal Medicine) Tue 15:00–21:30 and Wed 08:00–14:30; Diabetic Foot Clinic Wed 08:00–14:30. The walk-in emergency department is open 24/7 to visitors.
notes: UAE law requires HIV cases to be reported to the health authority, and residents who test positive face deportation; see the city notes before seeking HIV care here.

name.en: Thrive Wellbeing Centre
location.address.en: Office 706-710, HDS Tower, Cluster F, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai
location.locationNote: Second branch: Office 802, The Bridge, Dubai Sports City
hours: JLT: Mon–Fri 09:00–20:00, Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun 09:00–17:00. By appointment only.
services.note: Licensed psychologists carry out ADHD assessments (the page doesn't say for which ages each clinician assesses); DHA-licensed adult psychiatrists handle medication. Book via the online form; the team calls back.
notes: Child ADHD assessment may be available; confirm the clinician's age range when booking.

name.en: Hongkou District HIV Voluntary Counselling and Testing (VCT) Clinic
location.address.en: Room 104, 1F, 26 Changzhong Road, Hongkou District, Shanghai
hours: Mon & Fri 14:00–16:00; Wed 09:00–11:00 (no blood draws after 15:30 / 10:30). Closed public holidays.
services.note: Free counselling and rapid HIV testing (venous blood), free self-test kits. Bring ID. Shanghai has 200+ VCT sites; search the official VCT finder or the 上海疾控 WeChat account.

services.note: Community organisation (founded 2010) offering HIV counselling and testing and support for people living with HIV. WeChat: 上海青艾.

services.note: Endocrine and metabolic disease centre with diabetes care and a CAP-accredited endocrine laboratory.

services.note: Home of the Shanghai Diabetes Institute and the Shanghai Clinical Center for Diabetes. Diabetes and complications, obesity, thyroid and other endocrine disorders, with a multidisciplinary team; over 200,000 visits a year.
name.zh-Hans: 上海市第六人民医院 内分泌代谢科（上海市糖尿病研究所）

name.en: Shanghai Mental Health Center — Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
organization: Shanghai Mental Health Center (SJTU School of Medicine)
services.note: Outpatient assessment, diagnosis and treatment of ADHD for under-18s, a 25-bed inpatient ward, and ADHD parent education classes (a national ADHD health education base).
name.zh-Hans: 上海市精神卫生中心 儿童青少年精神科

name.en: Shanghai United Family Hospital (Changning)
services.note: Private hospital with multilingual staff. For PEP, go straight to the 24-hour emergency department; PEP must start within 72 hours (ideally within 2).

name.en: Service de diabétologie et endocrinologie — Hôpital Bichat-Claude-Bernard
location.address.en: 46 rue Henri-Huchard, 75018 Paris
services.note: Type 1 and type 2 diabetes, diabetic foot, insulin pump and closed-loop setup and follow-up, glucose Holter monitoring, and a day hospital for diabetes assessment and education. Book online (mon.aphp.fr) or call 01 40 25 82 42.

name.en: Service de maladies infectieuses et tropicales — Hôpital Bichat-Claude-Bernard
location.address.en: 46 rue Henri-Huchard, 75018 Paris
services.note: HIV infection and STIs are among the department's main areas; it has an urgent infectious diseases consultation and runs the hospital's CeGIDD. Book via Doctolib or phone. Sida Info Service says this department sees people without an appointment, including visitors who have run out of HIV treatment or PrEP; you pay for medicines at the pharmacy.

name.en: CeGIDD — Hôpital Bichat-Claude-Bernard
location.address.en: 46 rue Henri-Huchard, 75018 Paris
services.note: Dedicated PrEP consultation line: 01 40 25 72 79. PEP is listed for AP-HP CeGIDDs as a whole rather than this site. Free (or no upfront payment) HIV and STI screening, named or anonymous, open regardless of age or health coverage. Across AP-HP CeGIDDs, PrEP consultations are by appointment and PEP is given during opening hours (start within 48 hours) but not at weekends; at weekends go to an emergency department. Check current hours with Sida Info Service (0800 840 800).

name.en: CeGIDD Croix-Rouge Paris
location.address.en: 43 rue de Valois, 75001 Paris
services.note: Listed by Ville de Paris as a CeGIDD (free HIV, hepatitis and STI screening, open regardless of age or health coverage). Hours and PrEP/PEP availability not published in the sources; call first.

Check current hours with Sida Info Service (0800 840 800).

name.en: Checkpoint Paris
location.address.en: 13 rue d'Alexandrie, 75002 Paris
hours: About 70 hours a week, Mon–Sat, including evenings and Saturdays, with or without appointment (per 2024 activity report).
services.note: Community sexual health centre and CeGIDD for LGBT+ people and sex workers, including migrants without social security. Rapid HIV and hepatitis C tests, full STI check-ups with on-site chlamydia/gonorrhoea PCR (results in about 90 minutes), PrEP start and follow-up, PEP, vaccinations (hepatitis A/B, HPV, mpox), trans health and chemsex support. Free at the CeGIDD for people without health coverage or who want anonymity; professional interpreters used for some patients.

name.en: Centre médico-social Belleville (CeGIDD)
location.address.en: 218 rue de Belleville, 75020 Paris
location.nearestTransit: Télégraphe or Place des Fêtes (Métro 11); bus 60
hours: HIV/STI testing by appointment Mon–Fri 09:00–12:15 and 13:30–16:45 (to 18:45 Mon), Sat 09:15–12:15. Rapid HIV test (TROD) by appointment Mon 09:00–12:00 and 13:30–16:00, Wed and Thu 09:00–12:00. Results without appointment after 7 days. (Page dated August 2022; confirm.)
services.note: City-run CeGIDD: free, confidential HIV and STI testing. Booking via Doctolib. Ville de Paris says CeGIDDs are open regardless of age or health coverage. PrEP can be prescribed at CeGIDDs, but the city doesn't say which sites offer it.

name.en: Centre médico-social Ridder (CeGIDD)
location.address.en: 3 rue de Ridder, 75014 Paris
hours: HIV/STI testing by appointment Mon, Wed, Fri 12:00–17:30; Tue, Thu 09:00–17:30; Sat 09:15–11:15. Results without appointment Mon–Fri 12:00–18:30, Sat 09:15–11:45. (Page dated August 2022; confirm.)
services.note: City-run CeGIDD: free, confidential HIV and STI testing, with online booking. Ville de Paris says CeGIDDs are open regardless of age or health coverage. PrEP can be prescribed at CeGIDDs, but the city doesn't say which sites offer it.

name.en: Centre de santé sexuelle Frédéric Edelmann (Hôtel-Dieu)
location.address.en: 1 place du Parvis Notre-Dame, 75004 Paris
services.note: HIV, hepatitis and STI screening (including rapid tests) and STI treatment, free; PrEP start and follow-up; PEP prescription and follow-up (call first, or go to an emergency department and follow up here). Free self-tests and condoms. Access regardless of age or health coverage. Simultaneous interpretation for people who don't speak French. Santé.fr says visits are strictly by appointment (Doctolib or AP-HP portal), while AP-HP says with or without appointment; call to check. Urgent STI/PEP cases can be seen within 24–48 hours.

name.en: Consultation TDAH enfants et adolescents — GHU Paris (Sainte-Anne)
location.address.en: 1 rue Cabanis, 75014 Paris
services.note: Specialist ADHD (TDAH, with or without hyperactivity) consultation for children and adolescents at the Sainte-Anne site. Medication and referral rules aren't described in the source; call to ask.

name.en: Consultation TDA/H – Haut Potentiel — GHU Paris (Sainte-Anne)
location.address.en: Site Sainte-Anne, Bâtiment F, 1er étage, 1 rue Cabanis, 75014 Paris
services.note: ADHD and high-potential (giftedness) consultation for children, adolescents and adults. The same building (sector 75G04) also lists an adult neurodevelopmental disorders consultation (TDA/H – HP) without its own phone number. Medication and referral rules aren't described; call to ask.

name.en: Institut Alfred Fournier — Centre de santé sexuelle and CeGIDD
location.address.en: 25 boulevard Saint-Jacques, 75014 Paris
services.note: Listed by Ville de Paris as a sexual health centre (01 40 78 26 00) and CeGIDD (01 40 78 26 71) offering HIV and STI screening; visits with or without appointment. Ville de Paris says CeGIDDs are free and open regardless of age or health coverage. Hours not published; call first.

name.en: Département de diabétologie et endocrinologie (CUDC) — Hôpital Lariboisière
location.address.en: 2 rue Ambroise-Paré, 75010 Paris
location.locationNote: Outpatient Centre Universitaire de Diabétologie et de ses Complications (CUDC), Pavillon Servet.
services.note: Unstable type 1 diabetes including insulin pumps with closed-loop systems; FreeStyle glucose sensors and telemonitoring; therapeutic education; same-site consultations for kidney, eye, liver and heart complications. Book online (mon.aphp.fr) or call 01 49 95 89 77.

name.en: Le 190 — Centre de santé sexuelle
location.address.en: 90 rue Jean-Pierre Timbaud, 75011 Paris
services.note: Free information, screening and diagnosis centre for LGBT+ people and partners of people living with HIV. Offers consultations without appointment, urgent slots for PEP, new HIV infections and symptomatic STIs, and PrEP follow-up; the Île-de-France Region voted funding in 2026 to extend walk-in hours. Hours not published in the sources; call first.

name.en: Consultation Addictologie-TDAH — Hôpital Louis-Mourier
location.address.en: 178 rue des Renouillers, 92700 Colombes
location.locationNote: In Colombes, just north-west of Paris.
services.note: Adult psychiatry service offering specialised diagnostic consultations for adult ADHD (coordinated by Pr Yann Le Strat). Referral, waiting times and prescribing aren't described in the source; call to ask.

name.en: Service d'endocrinologie, gynécologie et diabétologie pédiatriques — Hôpital Necker-Enfants malades
location.address.en: 149 rue de Sèvres, 75015 Paris
services.note: Children and adolescents: type 1, slow-onset type 1 and monogenic diabetes, with therapeutic education and dietary, psychological and social support. First appointments online (mon.aphp.fr) or by phone.

name.en: Service de diabétologie — Hôpital Pitié-Salpêtrière
location.address.en: 47-83 boulevard de l'Hôpital, 75013 Paris
services.note: Reference centre: type 1, type 2, gestational, monogenic and other diabetes; diabetic foot and Charcot foot care; CGM, insulin pumps and closed-loop systems; therapeutic education in short-stay and day hospital units; islet transplantation. Book online via mon.aphp.fr; teleconsultation possible.

name.en: Service de maladies infectieuses et tropicales — Hôpital Pitié-Salpêtrière
location.address.en: 47-83 boulevard de l'Hôpital, 75013 Paris
location.locationNote: 'Pitié' entrance at 83 bd de l'Hôpital is open 24/7.
services.note: HIV infection, AIDS and STIs are listed areas of expertise; consultations see more than 10,000 patients a year. First appointment requests online, follow-ups via Doctolib. Sida Info Service says this department sees people without an appointment, including visitors who have run out of HIV treatment or PrEP; you pay for medicines at the pharmacy.

name.en: Service de psychiatrie de l'enfant et de l'adolescent — Hôpital Robert-Debré
location.address.en: 48 boulevard Sérurier, 75019 Paris
services.note: Babies and children up to age 15. The department includes a 'Centre d'excellence Trouble de l'attention et l'Hyperactivité' (ADHD centre of excellence). Request a first appointment online (AP-HP portal) or by phone. The page doesn't describe medication or referral rules; French public child psychiatry usually has waiting lists.

name.en: Service d'endocrinologie et diabétologie pédiatrique — Hôpital Robert-Debré
location.address.en: 48 boulevard Sérurier, 75019 Paris
services.note: Children and adolescents with type 1 (including slow-onset), monogenic and type 2 diabetes, hypoglycaemia and obesity. First visits need a health professional's referral and are booked via mon.aphp.fr.

name.en: Hôpital Saint-Antoine — Maladies infectieuses et tropicales and CeGIDD
location.address.en: 184 rue du Faubourg Saint-Antoine, 75012 Paris
services.note: CeGIDD: free HIV, hepatitis and STI screening, named or anonymous, without appointment. PrEP consultations at the CeGIDD. PEP after sexual or blood exposure: call the department or go to the hospital's emergency department. HIV and hepatitis B/C follow-up. Book via Doctolib, phone or email.

name.en: Service de maladies infectieuses et tropicales — Hôpital Saint-Louis
location.address.en: 1 avenue Claude-Vellefaux, 75010 Paris
location.nearestTransit: Goncourt (Métro 11) or Colonel Fabien (Métro 2); bus 46 or 75
hours: Walk-in infectious diseases consultation Mon–Fri from 08:30 (except public holidays; limited places, seen in order of arrival). Follow-up and PrEP by appointment (phone Mon–Fri 09:00–16:00, Doctolib or email).
services.note: HIV care from diagnosis to treatment and follow-up; dedicated PrEP consultation. Sida Info Service says the infectious diseases departments at Saint-Louis, Pitié-Salpêtrière and Bichat see people without an appointment, including visitors who have run out of HIV treatment or PrEP; you pay for medicines at the pharmacy.

name.en: 10 Hammersmith Broadway
organization: Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: 10 Hammersmith Broadway, London W6 7AL
hours: Mon–Tue 09:00–19:00; Wed 13:00–19:00; Thu 09:00–16:00; Fri 08:30–12:00. Closed weekends and bank holidays.
services.note: Rapid HIV tests, PrEP access and monitoring (book online), PEP after sexual exposure, STI testing and treatment, and follow-up care for people living with HIV. Same-day appointments are offered but limited; book by phone or online. For routine screening without symptoms the clinic points to Sexual Health London home testing kits. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: 56 Dean Street
organization: Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: 56 Dean Street, Soho, London W1D 6AQ
services.note: Free NHS sexual health and HIV clinic: STI testing and treatment, HIV testing, PEP, PrEP support and full outpatient HIV care. Book by phone or online; walk-in is mentioned only for people aged 19 or under. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: The ADHD Centre (London)
location.address.en: 85 Wimpole Street, London W1G 9RJ
location.locationNote: Second London clinic in Belgravia: 9 Eccleston Street, London SW1W 9LX. Online appointments by Zoom.
services.note: Private, consultant psychiatrist-led assessments for adults and children, with stimulant and non-stimulant medication prescribed and regular reviews. Assessments from £695; in-person adult assessment £1,095, child £1,695. The site advertises assessments within 24 hours to the same week and a written report within 2 weeks.

name.en: Ambrose King Sexual Health Centre (Royal London Hospital)
location.address.en: The Royal London Hospital, Mount Terrace, Whitechapel, London E1 2BB
services.note: Free, confidential sexual health services including screening with HIV testing, and contraception. Opening hours and walk-in rules aren't listed; call before going. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: Burrell Street Sexual Health Clinic
organization: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: 4-5 Burrell Street, London SE1 0UN
services.note: Walk-in, first come first served, for people with symptoms; priority for under-18s, emergency contraception and PEP. PrEP is by booked appointment only (phone 020 7188 6666, option 4). For a check-up without symptoms, order a home test kit online or collect one at reception. Arrive early; if the clinic is full you may be asked to come back the next day. Services are listed for the trust's sexual health service as a whole. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: Camberwell Sexual Health Centre
organization: King's College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: Ground floor, Camberwell Building, 100 Denmark Hill, London SE5 9RS
hours: Mon, Tue, Fri 08:00–15:30; Wed 12:00–18:30; Thu 10:00–17:30. Closed weekends and bank holidays.
services.note: Walk-in, first come first served, but you may not be seen the same day; booking online through Sexual Health London first is recommended. Priority for under-18s, PEP, emergency contraception and severe symptoms. CliniQ, for trans and non-binary people, is by appointment only. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: The Chelsea Psychology Clinic
location.address.en: 2 Eaton Gate, London SW1W 9BJ
location.locationNote: Also at 100 Harley Street (W1G 7JA), 45 Pont Street, Knightsbridge (SW1X 0BD), 84 Brook Street, Mayfair (W1K 5EH) and 96 Kensington High Street (W8 4SG).
services.note: Private ADHD assessments for adults (£1,000; combined autism/ADHD £3,500) and, through a separate service, children. A specialist psychiatrist discusses medication options at assessment; the page doesn't say whether the clinic itself prescribes and manages medication.

name.en: Clifden Centre (Homerton Sexual Health Services)
location.address.en: Homerton Row, London E9 6SR
hours: Walk-in Mon, Tue, Thu 09:00–11:30 with booked appointments in the afternoon; Wed 12:00–15:30; Fri 09:00–15:30. Booked Saturday clinic 10:00–15:00 every other Saturday. Men who have sex with men clinic Thu 17:00–19:00; Open Doors clinic for sex workers Thu 13:30–15:30.
services.note: Walk-in and booked appointments (walk-in sessions moved to mornings from 2 November). Routine tests include HIV and syphilis blood tests and chlamydia/gonorrhoea tests. Homerton's HIV care is at the Jonathan Mann Clinic. The trust's pages don't say which clinic offers PEP or PrEP; call 020 7683 4103. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: Evelina London Children's Hospital — Diabetes Service
organization: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: Evelina London Children's Hospital, Westminster Bridge Road, London SE1 7EH
hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. Out of hours, call 020 7188 7188, press 0 and ask for the children's diabetes on-call clinician.
services.note: Children and young people with diabetes: active insulin pump service, education with families and schools, transition to adult care, support in intensive care and for diabetes with kidney disease. The emergency department is always open.

name.en: Guy's and St Thomas' — Diabetes Service
organization: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: Diabetes and endocrine day centre, 3rd floor, Lambeth Wing, St Thomas' Hospital, Westminster Bridge Road, London SE1 7EH
location.locationNote: Also at Guy's Hospital (diabetes and endocrine unit, 3rd floor, Southwark Wing, Great Maze Pond, SE1 9RT) and Southwark community clinics.
services.note: Consultants in diabetes and endocrinology; insulin pump clinic; type 1, pregnancy, complex, kidney, genetic diabetes and a young adult clinic (16–24); individual and group education; podiatry-supported foot clinic; HEAL-D programme for people of Black African and Caribbean background with type 2 diabetes. Children under 16 are seen at Evelina London.

name.en: Ian Charleson Day Centre (Royal Free Hospital)
organization: Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust

services.note: Acıbadem's diabetes centre (DİYAM). A dedicated children's service is not described.
notes: English: Acıbadem Ataşehir Hospital — DİYAM Diabetes Centre.

name.en: Amerikan Hastanesi
location.locationNote: Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism: C Block, floor -1

notes: English: Prof. Dr. Cemil Taşcıoğlu City Hospital.

name.en: İstanbul Florence Nightingale Hastanesi
services.note: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry lists ADHD; assessment can include clinical interviews, psychometric tests and, if needed, EEG/MRI, and treatment can include medication (stimulants are mentioned for ADHD), psychotherapy and school-based support. name.en: Haydarpaşa Numune Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi

notes: English: Haydarpaşa Numune Training and Research Hospital.

name.en: Koç Üniversitesi Hastanesi
services.note: Adult endocrinology: diabetes nurses teach follow-up and insulin use, support type 1 pump users, and CGM is used; diabetic foot ulcers are managed in a weekly multidisciplinary meeting. Paediatric Endocrinology and Diabetes treats children with type 1 diabetes (incl. new diagnoses and DKA), starts insulin pumps with a 3-day outpatient programme, uses CGM for eligible children, and runs structured education, carbohydrate counting, diabetes camps and a Diabetes at School programme. International patients via kochealthcareinternational.org.
